notes: Publisher eager BF16 causal MLA prefill over the current token sequence. Q/K/V operands, QK output, scaled score, softmax probability and PV output are BF16-rounded at their storage boundaries; softmax reduction remains FP32. Workers claim complete token rows with private score scratch. This provider does not read persistent KV history, so appended prefill rows require history-aware execution or decode replay.
